Messages.Author: me3845
Messages.Body: If I have control of a vampire that has a temptation card on it and I have control of him. When I take out the Methuselah who that vampire belongs too. Do I keep the vampire or is he removed from the game?

Messages.Author: 1up20x6
Messages.Body:
Golden Rule of Card Ownership: If you are ousted before the end of a game, any of your cards that other Methuselahs are currently controlling remain in play before they are burned.

So you keep the vampire until it is burned, but once it is, it's gone for good.

Any deck can win, whether you're using stealth bleed, rush combat, or Soul Gem combos. It doesn't matter if your minions use Auspex, Thaumaturgy, or Melpominee. What matters is the Methuselah uses Presence. That is how deals are made. That is how games are won.

No, you misunderstand. I don't want...
